create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Nazaré
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Nazaré is a small traditional shala in the Atlantic fishing town of Nazaré, on Portugal's Silver Coast, run by the married teachers Sérgio Ramos and Vanessa José. Between them they bring more than fifteen years of Ashtanga practice; Sérgio holds Level 2 authorisation from the Sharath Yoga Centre in Mysore, and the couple previously directed the Mysore programme at Ashtanga Yoga Porto from 2020 to 2024 before moving to Nazaré to live closer to the land.

The shala runs a full Mysore programme on weekday and Saturday mornings in a first-floor room in the town centre, open to complete beginners as well as experienced students, with a led primary class on Saturdays and rest on new- and full-moon days; there are also evening Mysore sessions, a pranayama class and online classes for those further away. Philosophy has a strong place in their teaching. Sérgio leads a self-paced video course on the first chapter of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, read verse by verse, and the school's YouTube channel holds long talks in Portuguese on the yamas and niyamas, practice and detachment, and the eight limbs, alongside demonstrations of the second and advanced series. Classes are taught in Portuguese and English.

courses.title: In-person Mysore and led classes (passes)
courses.description: Passes for the Nazaré shala's morning Mysore programme, evening sessions and Saturday led class, from a single drop-in to a monthly pass covering every class. Students facing financial difficulty are invited to get in touch.
courses.price: € Mensalidade 108 (all classes for a month); 2-week pass 75; 1-week pass 60; drop-in 20; 4 classes/month 40

courses.title: Aulas Online (online classes)
courses.description: Live online group classes with Sérgio and Vanessa for students who cannot reach Nazaré, plus private online sessions by appointment.

courses.title: Study of the Yoga Sutras: Samādhi Pada
courses.description: A self-paced course led by Sérgio Ramos on the 51 verses of the first chapter of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, in five recorded one-hour classes with the text in Sanskrit, transliteration and translation, and a group chat for questions. Access lasts four months.
